metric_definitions.d: logp_variant - logp_baseline of the gold token (fp32 values, fp64 difference)
metric_definitions.bits_differ: fp32 bit patterns of the two logp values differ
metric_definitions.k3: exp(d) - d - 1 (fp64) of the gold token; a mismatch size, NOT a KL (the tokens are gold answers, not samples of either distribution)
metric_definitions.kl_full: KL(baseline || variant) over the full vocabulary per position, fp64 sum of the two fp32 log_softmax rows (HF settings measured in the main part only; None for derived / cross / strict records)
metric_definitions.argmax_flip: argmax id of the variant logits != the baseline's (HF only); var_argmax holds the variant ids
metric_definitions.argmax_flips_unique / argmax_flips_at_ti: flips where both top-1 logits are unique / where either run has a top-1 tie (top2_gap == 0; the bf16 logits tie exactly and argmax returns the lowest tied id)
metric_definitions.derived_from_stored_values: record computed in the merge from two measured settings' exact per-token values (logp_hex, argmax ids, top-2 gaps), no extra forward
metric_definitions.dlogp/k3/kl_full arrays: rounded to 6/4/6 significant digits; logp_hex is exact
metric_definitions.n_factors: factors the comparison against its baseline flips (0 = null control)
